summary.business_type: Creator education + paid community (Skool, $29/$49/$89 per month) with YouTube channel and written guides
top_findings: 173 of 220 /watch/ pages are thin (<300 words, median ~210); only 30 have transcripts and they sit in a collapsed <details>
Watch pages cannibalize guides: searchTitle overrides in src/watch-notes.js copy guide head terms (HeyGen exact duplicate; OpenCode, 9Router, Vapi near-duplicates)
Brand entity is weak: 'AI Income Lab' is absent from schema, Organization has no logo, and other Skool communities use the same name
Internal linking is one-directional: 1 of 220 watch pages links a topic hub, only 3 of 24 guides link their hub, and the 'earn with AI' cluster has no hub or pillar
Watch pages load the full YouTube player (~1.1 MB) on page load instead of a click-to-load facade
quick_wins: Add Organization logo + alternateName 'AI Income Lab' and fix WebSite.alternateName in index.html
Retitle /watch/pMLyxz6Dyt4 and other searchTitle overrides that copy guide titles (src/watch-notes.js)
Add topic level to watch-page breadcrumbs and a hub link (src/archive.js)
Write descriptive alt text for the 9 guide hero diagrams (public/guides/*.html)
Reuse the homepage YouTube facade on /watch/ pages (src/archive.js:261, pattern from src/main.jsx:268)
limitations: No Google API credentials: no CrUX field data, GSC indexation or GA4 traffic
PageSpeed Insights API rate-limited; Core Web Vitals are local Lighthouse 13.6 lab data
No Moz / Bing / Keywords Everywhere keys; domain not yet in Common Crawl web graph, so backlinks are not scored
SERP checks used a 5-result web search sample, not a full Google top 10

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 274 crawled pages return 200; 0 broken internal links; self-referencing canonicals everywhere
308 redirects to https://www; /guides/x -> .html, trailing slash and /index.html normalized
Real 404s with noindex for unknown paths, video IDs and topics
Both sitemaps valid; video sitemap has all required video: tags; IndexNow wired into scripts/prerender.js
Brotli, HTTP/2, immutable hashed assets, HSTS, nosniff, XFO DENY

findings.title: Most /watch/ pages are thin
findings.description: 173 of 220 under 300 words; only YouTube description is unique on most.
findings.recommendation: Finish transcript backfill; surface summary/first transcript paragraphs outside <details> in renderWatch (src/archive.js).

findings.title: 23 /videos URLs in sitemap.xml lack <lastmod>
findings.description: 29 of 52 main-sitemap URLs have lastmod.
findings.recommendation: Emit newest upload date per page in renderPageSitemap() (src/archive.js).

findings.title: Homepage <lastmod> stale and hard-coded
findings.description: Sitemap says 2026-10-16; homepage shows a 2026-10-27 video.
findings.recommendation: Generate at build time in public/sitemap.xml pipeline.

findings.title: Two-hop redirect chains
findings.description: http apex -> https apex -> www; /guides/x/ -> /guides/x -> /guides/x.html.
findings.recommendation: Add direct rules in vercel.json redirects.

findings.title: CSP is Report-Only with no report endpoint
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only only.
findings.recommendation: Add report-to, review, then enforce in vercel.json.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Guides have bylines, published/updated dates, primary sources, honest caveats and no income promises
Guides average ~1,570 words with readability 51-67, quick answers, tables, FAQs
Best watch pages (e.g. /watch/TuVL2x6IfDk) add chapters, build notes, fact-checks and transcripts

findings.title: Thin, templated watch pages
findings.description: Median watch page ~210 words; /watch/wL6bjqaUcd8 (117 words) is YouTube description + generic CTA.
findings.recommendation: Transcripts + notes for all 220 (scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs, src/watch-notes.js); noindex,follow pages with neither until enriched.

findings.title: No standalone author/About page
findings.description: Bylines and Person schema point to /#about on a mixed-purpose homepage; YMYL-adjacent money guides.
findings.recommendation: Create /about.html with bio, sameAs, editorial process; point bylines there.

findings.title: Make-money guides lack first-hand proof and sources
findings.description: make-money-with-ai-no-experience and ai-side-hustles have no external links; 5 guides overlap on 'make money with AI'.
findings.recommendation: Add one documented case, sources and a comparison table per guide; de-stuff keyword headings.

findings.title: 14 of 24 guides lack a quick-answer opener
findings.description: ai-automation.html shows the strong pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add 40-60 word answer after the H1.

findings.title: Transcripts are raw auto-captions
findings.description: 'codeex', 'Versal' on /watch/TuVL2x6IfDk.
findings.recommendation: Add a term-correction pass to scripts/fetch-transcripts.mjs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: No missing/duplicate meta descriptions; one H1 per page
Descriptive anchor text sitewide; Skool CTA on 271 of 274 pages
make-money-with-ai-fast observed at #1 in sampled SERP

findings.title: Watch pages cannibalize guides
findings.description: Identical title on /guides/heygen-ai-avatar-tutorial.html and /watch/pMLyxz6Dyt4; near-duplicates for OpenCode, 9Router, Vapi.
findings.recommendation: Retitle watch pages as video walkthroughs in src/watch-notes.js; add a test blocking guide/watch title collisions.

findings.title: Internal links don't connect clusters
findings.description: 1 of 220 watch pages links a topic hub; 66 watch pages map to no hub; only 3 of 24 guides link their hub; 'earn with AI' cluster has no hub/pillar.
findings.recommendation: Add topic level to watch breadcrumbs (src/archive.js ~230, ~259), a business topic in src/topics.js, and guide<->hub links.

findings.title: Small-business guide targets the wrong intent
findings.description: Head term SERP is agency service pages (4/5); guide is written for sellers.
findings.recommendation: Retitle to the seller query in public/guides/ai-automation-services-small-business.html.

findings.title: Thin topic hubs with short titles
findings.description: /videos/n8n title 'n8n videos | Mike Holp' (22 chars), H1 'n8n'.
findings.recommendation: 55-65 char titles, descriptive H1s and 150-300 word intros in src/topics.js.

findings.title: Over-broad guide-routing regex
findings.description: codex|open code|claude code sends 13 of 15 Claude Code videos to the Codex guide.
findings.recommendation: Order specific patterns before broad ones in src/archive.js.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: No invalid JSON-LD; consistent @id graph (#mike, #org, #website) across pages
VideoObject complete on 220 watch pages, 195 with Clip key moments
Article complete on all 24 guides; BreadcrumbList on 246 pages

findings.title: Organization has no logo
findings.description: No logo/image on #org or Article publishers; no logo file in public/.
findings.recommendation: Add square PNG logo (>=112px) and reference from index.html.

findings.title: 'AI Income Lab' missing from schema
findings.description: Organization named 'AI Automation Station' with no alternateName; WebSite.alternateName is 'Mike Holp'.
findings.recommendation: Add alternateName ['AI Income Lab'] to #org and fix WebSite.alternateName in index.html.

findings.title: No Product/Offer/Course markup for the paid community
findings.description: Visible $29/$49/$89 tiers and five courses are unmarked.
findings.recommendation: Add Product + Offers and ItemList of Course (snippet B in findings/schema.md).

findings.title: Inconsistent Person URL and sameAs
findings.description: Person url is / on home/watch vs /#about elsewhere; YouTube missing from Person sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Normalize in index.html and src/archive.js:226; add YouTube, worksFor.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: All tested URLs pass lab LCP/CLS/TBT on mobile and desktop; TTFB <60 ms
Lighthouse SEO and accessibility 100 on every tested page
Third-party tags gated behind consent; homepage uses a YouTube facade

findings.title: Watch pages load the full YouTube player eagerly
findings.description: ~1.1 MB from youtube-nocookie.com; mobile LCP 2.12 s, the slowest tested.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the homepage facade (src/main.jsx:268) in src/archive.js:261; preconnect i.ytimg.com.

findings.title: Meta pixel adds ~279 KB and ~250-300 ms blocking after consent
findings.description: Not visible to Lighthouse, which runs pre-consent; main INP risk.
findings.recommendation: Defer injection to idle in loadMarketingTracking (src/tracking.js); consider Conversions API.

findings.title: No real-user CWV monitoring
findings.description: No CrUX key, no @vercel/speed-insights; analytics absent on guides and watch pages.
findings.recommendation: Add Speed Insights and analytics across all templates.

findings.title: Late font discovery on guide/watch pages
findings.description: CLS 0.065 on watch mobile from fonts declared only in reading.css.
findings.recommendation: Preload the two WOFF2 fonts in those heads.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All 15 tested AI/search crawler UAs receive identical 200 responses
Quality llms.txt; server-rendered HTML; dated, sourced guides
ai-automation.html is a model citable page (quick answer, FAQ, table, 17 sources)

findings.title: Brand name collides with other 'AI Income Lab' communities
findings.description: Other Skool groups use the same name; observed rankings varied between checks, and AI summaries can blend them. Mike's Skool slug is ai-automation-station-7346.
findings.recommendation: Pair the name with 'by Mike Holp' in titles, llms.txt and Skool description; add schema alternateName.

findings.title: Few independent third-party mentions
findings.description: Only checkthecourse.com found as an independent source.
findings.recommendation: Earn mentions on Reddit, podcasts, collaborator channels; Wikidata once sources exist.

findings.title: No /llms-full.txt or About page
findings.description: Both return 404.
findings.recommendation: Add /about.html; optionally enrich llms.txt with per-link descriptions and topic hubs.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 587 images have width/height; 563 lazy-loaded
Empty alt on ~490 thumbnails/avatars beside text is correct decorative usage

findings.title: Guide hero diagrams have empty alt
findings.description: 9 informative hero images in public/guides/*.html have alt="".
findings.recommendation: Write descriptive alt text and add an alt check to src/guide-seo.test.js.

findings.title: Mostly JPG/PNG
findings.description: 403 jpg, 128 png, 56 webp (many are YouTube-hosted thumbnails).
findings.recommendation: Use WebP/AVIF for self-hosted images.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Brand entity: logo + alternateName 'AI Income Lab' + Person sameAs/url fixes in index.html
Retitle watch pages that duplicate guide titles (src/watch-notes.js) and add a collision test
Add topic level to watch breadcrumbs and hub links (src/archive.js)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Finish transcript backfill; surface summary outside <details>; noindex unenriched watch pages
Create 'earn with AI' topic hub + pillar guide; link guides <-> hubs; fix guide-routing regex
Retitle small-business guide for the seller query
Create /about.html and point bylines and Person schema there
Alt text on 9 guide hero diagrams

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add sources, case studies and tables to the make-money guides
Quick-answer openers on remaining 14 guides; question-style H2s
Expand topic hub intros/titles in src/topics.js

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console / CrUX API to the SEO toolkit; add Vercel Speed Insights
Defer Meta pixel; consider Conversions API
Create a drift baseline and re-audit monthly
Sitemap lastmod generation; redirect chain cleanup; enforce CSP
